/* Generated by scripts/build-square-notes.cjs — do not edit by hand.
 *
 * Two write-ups per square of the board of rebirth, keyed by square number:
 * SQUARE_NOTES is the short one, shown as soon as a square is opened, and
 * SQUARE_FULL is the long one it expands to. Both are authored as Markdown in
 * content/squares-1-104-blurbs.md and content/squares-1-104-full.md, which is
 * where they are edited; run the script again afterwards.
 *
 * Markdown is reduced here to the little HTML the drawer renders — <b>, <i>,
 * lists, a <blockquote class="verse"> for quoted verse, and a link carrying
 * data-sq that opens another square — because both values are written into the
 * sheet with innerHTML.
 *
 * Names, categories, the Tibetan on each square, the move graph and the 3D
 * placement live in rebirth-board.js and are untouched by this file. Nothing
 * here affects play.
 */
